summary.zh: 为未订阅客户撰写冷邮件及跟进序列
summary.en: Draft cold outreach and follow-up sequences for prospects

description.zh: 为未主动订阅的潜在客户撰写首次触达邮件和后续跟进序列，并按长度、个性化程度和垃圾邮件风险逐封打分。适合 SDR 外呼前检查初稿。
description.en: Writes first-touch emails and follow-up sequences for prospects who never opted in, then scores each message for length, personalization and spam risk. Useful for reviewing SDR drafts before sending.
